input_schema.role: exact frozen patched ClosedNormalizedProgram structural language; hash-verify before generate

Q1_provenance.summary: Mechanically generated grammar from hash-verified patched schema; hand-patch forbidden; pure deterministic transform with grammar + generator hashes

Q2_object_ordering.summary: Canonical fixed property order for schema-closed objects; any-order allowlist = ClosedNormalizedTask.produces_binds only; order derived from persisted schema property order

Q3_produces_binds.summary: Map surface {} or {"json-string":"track"(, ...)*}; duplicate dynamic keys not CFG-guaranteed; JSON parse + freeze_candidate authoritative for dict materialization; exception narrowly scoped to map-key uniqueness

Q4_xor.summary: ClosedSemanticQuery ::= TextQuery | LocalRefQuery exclusive productions; both/neither unreachable; no oneOf runtime; no post-parse XOR fallback

Q5_nonempty_json_string.summary: Decode-faithful NONEMPTY_JSON_STRING matching str(value).strip()!=""; classify by decoded atoms including escapes; raw-source .*\\S.* forbidden; Unicode-only narrowing forbidden; fail closed if unrepresentable

Q6_numbers.summary: Full numeric lexical surface of pinned JSON/Pydantic parse path for schema number; no deliberate spelling subset; semantic numeric domain remains freeze_candidate

Q7_optionals_null_defaults.summary: Sequential optional slots with NoPrior/HasPrior comma machine; required never skippable; defaults never grammar-materialized; absence/null/false/0/[] remain distinct where schema distinguishes

Q8_arrays_nesting.summary: Mechanical arrays [] | [T(,T)*]; honor only schema min/maxItems; shared $ref nonterminals; uniqueItems unrepresentable → FAIL; no invented caps; no inferred min tasks

Q9_ordinary_strings.summary: Full pinned JSON string language for plain type:string including empty; Q5 nonempty only for ClosedSemanticQuery text/local_ref

Q10_insignificant_whitespace.summary: Zero insignificant JSON whitespace; separators ',' and ':'; compact only; string contents unaffected

T11_metalanguage.summary: Restricted WellPlot-owned engine-neutral EBNF dialect; exact textual syntax part of design before generator impl; optional deterministic engine lowering as second pure transform; engine syntax not source contract

T13_enum_const.summary: Finite mechanical alternation of exact JSON literals from schema; schema array order for enum; pinned canonical JSON literal serializer

T14_unions.summary: Closed whitelist: nullable T|null; exact language-union anyOf when every branch compilable; Q4 XOR special transform; other oneOf/not/if/allOf/unknown → GENERATOR_FAIL; no best-effort widening

T15_integer_vs_number.summary: integer → pinned authoritative integer acceptance language; number → Q6; no assumed regex from memory; FAIL if unrepresentable

T16_root.summary: START ::= ClosedNormalizedProgram sole entry; Q2/Q7 root object; no wrapper/prefix/suffix/whitespace

T18_provenance.summary: Canonical WELL-EBNF-1 bytes + full transform provenance including runtime/parser/Unicode identities for Q5/Q6/T15; input_schema_sha256 must equal preflight patched schema

T19_generator_fail.summary: No weaken/fallback modes; hard-failure catalogue + UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_CONSTRUCT catch-all

T20_engine_requirements.summary: Requirements only; consume WELL-EBNF-1 or language-preserving lowering; hard token mask; fidelity to Q2–Q10/T15; fail closed; provenance; practical constructibility; candidates deferred; install/probe/PILOT not authorized

well_ebnf_1_requirements: mechanically generated Unicode scalar/range terminals sufficient for Q5/Q9
well_ebnf_1_note: Exact textual syntax of WELL-EBNF-1 is part of the design contract and must be fully specified before generator implementation; this closeout freezes the dialect identity and requirements, not a complete metasyntax document.
